description: This file defines the ProgressiveTransactionCtx class, which extends TransactionCtx, and manages contextual data related to progressive loan transactions, including schedule models, processed transactions, and various state flags.

classes.name: ProgressiveTransactionCtx
classes.description: A specialized transaction context for handling progressive loan transactions, maintaining schedule models, processed transactions, and flags relating to the account state.

methods.name: ProgressiveTransactionCtx
methods.description: Constructor initializing the context with currency, installments, charges, overpayment, change details, a schedule model, and optionally the sum of interest refunds.
